BiblicalUsage: Madveh is sickness, disease, and both of its appearances are about the diseases of Egypt. Deuteronomy 7:15 promises the LORD will take away all sickness and put none of the evil diseases of Egypt upon His people, while Deuteronomy 28:60 warns He will bring upon them all the diseases of Egypt if they turn away.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the two verses are one promise with two edges: obedience keeps the diseases off, and disobedience brings them back.
